detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same two people throughout, the woman in a grey-blue apron pushing and the young man in a pale-blue shirt being pushed. The camera holds a static shot. Her right hand is already pressed to his back and his head is already turned back to the left; her left hand comes up onto his shoulder and both of them move two paces toward the right of frame, the suitcase wheels turning, while his head stays turned back for a beat longer. The speaker (S1) says, hurrying, pushing the sentence forward, <d>[Chinese] 快把行李放进去，歇会儿就开饭了，</d> wheels on polished stone, soft-soled steps. Her right hand nudges his head back to the front and both of them keep moving toward the right edge of frame until only their near shoulders remain. The speaker (S1) says, still quick, dropping the pitch at the end, <d>[Chinese] 你表叔一会儿就回来。</d>

overall_soundscape:
Wheels on polished stone, soft-soled steps.
